query: WITH workers AS ( SELECT total_wage, job_sector FROM estishraf_llm_jobs_info_v3_impala WHERE is_active_job = 1 AND CAST(id AS STRING) LIKE '1%' AND total_wage BETWEEN 100 AND 600000) SELECT job_sector, ROUND(AVG(total_wage)) AS avg_monthly_wage FROM workers GROUP BY job_sector ORDER BY avg_monthly_wage DESC LIMIT 1200
raw_question: ماهي متوسطات رواتب السعوديين في كل قطاع؟
